name: datto-bcdr-mcp
description: Sync your whole Datto BCDR fleet into local SQLite and answer the questions the per-appliance Partner Portal can't: which backups failed screenshot verification, which are stale, and which clients are at risk.

datto_bcdr_public_key.title: DATTO_BCDR_PUBLIC_KEY
datto_bcdr_public_key.description: Sets DATTO_BCDR_PUBLIC_KEY for the Datto BCDR MCP server.

datto_bcdr_secret_key.title: DATTO_BCDR_SECRET_KEY
datto_bcdr_secret_key.description: Sets DATTO_BCDR_SECRET_KEY for the Datto BCDR MCP server.

datto_bcdr_base_url.title: Datto BCDR API base URL
datto_bcdr_base_url.description: Base URL for the Datto BCDR API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

datto_bcdr_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
datto_bcdr_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

datto_bcdr_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
datto_bcdr_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Datto BCDR requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only used when the MCP server is bound to a tenant-gated Printing Press client profile. This connector registers no tenant-gated source, so leave it blank unless you set one up yourself.
